## VantaVault v0.5.30

Run your party from VantaVault, see how you and your duo play together, and get a new look at your own stats.

### Highlights
- **Insights, rebuilt** (insights): Your playstyle radar, an archetype like Fragger or Anchor, what changed in your last 20 matches and your best recent game.
- **Compare, face to face** (compare): Open any player's profile to put your player cards side by side, with playstyle and match stats head to head.
- **Profile badges** (badges): Earned from real stats, like Headhunter, Night Owl or Tilt Prone. Hover one to see what earned it.

### Added
- Party controls: pick the queue, ready up, start or cancel the queue and switch the party between open and invite only, right from the friends panel.
- Invite friends with one click. The list only shows friends who are in VALORANT and not in a match.
- Your account standing shows next to the party: good standing, active penalties or a queue restriction with the time left.
- Duos in your profile: everyone you queued with, who backs who up, your best agent pairs and your latest trades.
- Pick your player colours in Duos. Compare uses the same colours.
- Accolades in your profile, with your personal bests.
- Undo a loadout change: after applying a preset or skin, put your previous loadout back in one click.
- A short recap of your session when you close VALORANT.
- Friends are grouped by game, with the real League of Legends and Teamfight Tactics logos.
- Leaderboard search finds players from Riot as well as the rows already loaded.

### Improved
- The profile menu is easier to scan, with each tool in its own colour.
- Profiles load with a card scan that follows what has actually loaded.
- Insights waits until everything has loaded, with a short loading animation.

### Fixed
- Reopening VantaVault after a long break no longer switches to another saved account or needs a refresh.
- Renewing a session now reloads your equipped loadout as well as the shop.
- Party tags like 4-STACK no longer wrap in match history.
- Preset errors now say what actually went wrong.
- Compare no longer shows empty stats when nobody has played this act yet.

### Download
- **Windows Portable:** `VantaVault-portable.exe` — run directly with no setup.
- **Windows Installer:** `VantaVault_0.5.30_x64-setup.exe` — optional per-user installation.

### Auto-update
Both Windows release types update from inside VantaVault. Android debug and signed builds are produced through the repository workflows and are not published on Google Play.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/akawazak/valo-project/compare/v0.5.29...v0.5.30
